analysis: Exploratory paired conditional group bootstrap of calibration-only repair gain
reference: 20% imaging, original 30%/50% flag caps and original complete criterion; primary vs repaired
sampling: Within each of 2 cohorts x 5 evaluation batches, draw G groups with replacement from the original G groups. Keep every lesion in a sampled group, including excluded endpoints. Reuse the same group multiplicities for all five models, both flag caps and both stages in that stratum.
recomputed: Counts, cohort size, sensitivity requirements, imaging and flag caps, protected cancer identities and feasibility are recomputed in each bootstrap sample. Fitted scores, numerical decision thresholds, labels, group assignments and model/calibration fits remain fixed.
estimand: Equal-configuration repaired-minus-primary feasibility proportion across the 100-table reference grid, in percentage points; one primary contrast.
interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of paired replicate differences, NumPy linear quantile; no p-values.
secondary: Per-cohort/cap differences and per-system/cohort/cap fold pass counts archived descriptively.
validation: Original 200 table verdicts and count distributions must match archived inputs; compare selected resamples against independently specified allocation MILP with integer witness checks.
timing: Plan written before running this new bootstrap, after review of published-in-draft reference results; exploratory, not preregistered.
